mapper.select: SELECT mr.*, mi.mat_name AS medicine_name, mi.manufacturer, pi.pond_name, pi.pond_code FROM med_record mr LEFT JOIN mat_info mi ON mr.drug_mat_id = mi.id LEFT JOIN pond_info pi ON mr.pond_id = pi.id WHERE mr.pond_id = #{pondId} AND mr.ban_harvest_until >= CURDATE() ORDER BY mr.ban_harvest_until DESC

SELECT mr.*, mi.mat_name AS medicine_name, mi.manufacturer, pi.pond_name, pi.pond_code FROM med_record mr LEFT JOIN mat_info mi ON mr.drug_mat_id = mi.id LEFT JOIN pond_info pi ON mr.pond_id = pi.id WHERE mr.pond_id = #{pondId} AND mr.ban_harvest_until > #{date} ORDER BY mr.ban_harvest_until DESC
